60331-the-man-on-the-other-side.title: The Man On The Other Side
60331-the-man-on-the-other-side.creator: Ada Barnett
60331-the-man-on-the-other-side.description: A book by Ada Barnett. se stood high, and she could see on the one hand the dust-white road winding for the whole mile to Mentmore station; on the other, green fields and good brown earth, woodland, valley, and hill, stretching to the wide spaces of the downs, beyond which lay the sea. In 1919, the year of the Great Peace, spring had come late, but in added and surpassing beauty.

arxiv-2012-00994.title: Microscopic analysis of high harmonic generation in semiconductors with degenerate bands
arxiv-2012-00994.creator: Le Huu Thong, Cong Ngo, Huynh Thanh Duc, Xiaohong Song, Torsten Meier
arxiv-2012-00994.description: Abstract Based on the multiband semiconductor Bloch equations a microscopic approach to high-harmonic generation in crystalline solids which is able to properly describe degenerate bands and band crossings is presented and analyzed. It is well-known that numerical band structure calculations typically provide electronic wave functions with an undetermined k-dependent phase which results in matrix elements which contain arbitrary k-dependent phases.

arxiv-2103-09330.title: Cross-Task Instance Representation Interactions and Label Dependencies for Joint Information Extraction with Graph Convolutional Networks
arxiv-2103-09330.creator: Minh Van Nguyen, Viet Dac Lai, Thien Huu Nguyen
arxiv-2103-09330.description: Abstract Existing works on information extraction (IE) have mainly solved the four main tasks separately (entity mention recognition, relation extraction, event trigger detection, and argument extraction), thus failing to benefit from inter-dependencies between tasks. This paper presents a novel deep learning model to simultaneously solve the four tasks of IE in a single model (called FourIE).

arxiv-2112-03244.title: Projection methods for Neural Field equations
arxiv-2112-03244.creator: Daniele Avitabile
arxiv-2112-03244.description: Abstract Neural field models are nonlinear integro-differential equations for the evolution of neuronal activity, and they are a prototypical large-scale, coarse-grained neuronal model in continuum cortices. Neural fields are often simulated heuristically and, in spite of their popularity in mathematical neuroscience, their numerical analysis is not yet fully established.

arxiv-2208-04980.title: An NLP-Assisted Bayesian Time Series Analysis for Prevalence of Twitter Cyberbullying During the COVID-19 Pandemic
arxiv-2208-04980.creator: Christopher Perez (cperez7@ufl.edu), Sayar Karmakar (sayarkarmakar@ufl.edu)*
arxiv-2208-04980.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Christopher Perez (cperez7@ufl.edu), Sayar Karmakar (sayarkarmakar@ufl.edu)*. COVID-19 has brought about many changes in social dynamics. Stay-at-home orders and disruptions in school teaching can influence bullying behavior in-person and online, both of which leading to negative outcomes in victims. To study cyberbullying specifically, 1 million tweets containing keywords associated with abuse were collected from the beginning of 2019 to the end of 2021 with the Twitter API search endpoint.

arxiv-2208-10545.title: Information-theoretical analysis of the neural code for decoupled face representation
arxiv-2208-10545.creator: Miguel Ibáñez-Berganza, Carlo Lucibello, Luca Mariani, Giovanni Pezzulo
arxiv-2208-10545.description: Abstract Processing faces accurately and efficiently is a key capability of humans and other animals that engage in sophisticated social tasks. Recent studies reported a decoupled coding for faces in the primate inferotemporal cortex, with two separate neural populations coding for the geometric position of (texture-free) facial landmarks and for the image texture at fixed landmark positions, respectively.

arxiv-2305-03084.title: A Chandra X-ray Study of Supernova Remnant N63A in the Large Magellanic Cloud 2015 A Chandra X-ray Study of Supernova Remnant N63A in the Large Magellanic Cloud – References
arxiv-2305-03084.creator: E. Karagöz, N. Alan, S. Bilir, S. Ak
arxiv-2305-03084.description: Abstract We perform extensive spectroscopy of the supernova remnant N63A in the Large Magellanic Cloud, using ∼ 43 \sim 43 ks Chandra archival data. By analysing the spectra of the entire remnant, we determine the abundance distributions for O, Ne, Mg, Si, and Fe.

arxiv-2307-09505.title: Statistics of magnification for extremely lensed high redshift stars
arxiv-2307-09505.creator: J. M. Palencia, J. M. Diego, B. J. Kavanagh, J. Martinez
arxiv-2307-09505.description: Abstract Microlensing of stars in strongly lensed galaxies can lead to temporary extreme magnification factors ( μ > 1000 \mu\!>\!1000 ), enabling their detection at high redshifts. Following the discovery of Icarus, several stars at cosmological distances ( z > 1 z\!>\!1 ) have been observed using the Hubble Space Telescope (HST) and the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST).

arxiv-2311-04987.title: Sensitivity of JWST to eV-Scale Decaying Axion Dark Matter
arxiv-2311-04987.creator: Sandip Roy, Carlos Blanco, Christopher Dessert, Anirudh Prabhu, Tea Temim
arxiv-2311-04987.description: Abstract The recently-launched James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) can resolve eV-scale emission lines arising from dark matter (DM) decay. We forecast the end-of-mission sensitivity to the decay of axions, a leading DM candidate, in the Milky Way using the blank-sky observations expected during standard operations. Searching for unassociated emission lines will constrain axions in the mass range 0.18 0.

arxiv-2510-26874.title: Gravitational waveforms from restriction theory and rapid-decay homology
arxiv-2510-26874.creator: Giacomo Brunello, Vsevolod Chestnov, Giulio Crisanti, Mathieu Giroux, Sid Smith
arxiv-2510-26874.description: Abstract We present a systematic framework for computing frequency-domain gravitational waveforms from relativistic binary scattering in different asymptotic regimes. The method yields a controlled series expansion that can in principle be extended to arbitrary order in the relevant kinematic parameter.

arxiv-2512-14903.title: Bayesian Latent Class Regression and Variable Selection with Applications to Sleep Patterns Data
arxiv-2512-14903.creator: Matthew Heaney, Olive Healy, Jason Wyse, Arthur White
arxiv-2512-14903.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Matthew Heaney, Olive Healy, Jason Wyse, Arthur White. Sleep difficulties in children are heterogeneous in presentation, yet conventional assessment tools like the Children’s Sleep Habits Questionnaire (CSHQ) reduce this complexity to a single cumulative score, obscuring distinct patterns of sleep disturbance that require different interventions.

pmc-10701867.title: Nanofluidic Membrane with Spent Battery Residues for Efficient Energy Generation
pmc-10701867.creator: Zhenzhen Guo, Yuchuan Xiong, Yurong Han, Yueyue Wang, Muhammad Sultan Irshad, Xianbao Wang
pmc-10701867.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Harvesting energy in the ambient environment has become a dominant energy source and is promising toward a sustainable perspective. However, developing an energy generator with readily available raw materials and continuous output performance remains a challenge. Herein, we have demonstrated that a nanofluidic membrane with an asymmetric structure device (ASD) design by using available raw materials spent battery residues can achieve continuous power generation. The ASD can generate a voltage of ∼0.5 V by dropping 0.1 mL of water.

pmc-11348490.title: Improving humanitarian health responses for children through nurturing care
pmc-11348490.creator: Ayesha Kadir, Linda Doull, James McQuen Patterson, Mushtaq Khan, Rachael Cummings, Douglas James Noble, Anshu Banerjee
pmc-11348490.description: Children are disproportionately impacted by humanitarian disasters, which cause toxic stress. When a crisis overwhelms the capacity of health and social systems to meet the needs of a population, external crisis response teams working in a range of sectors may offer support to save lives and meet the affected populations' basic needs.

pmc-11498713.title: Moving towards a core measures set for patient safety in perioperative care: An e-Delphi consensus study
pmc-11498713.creator: J. P. Dinis-Teixeira, Ana Beatriz Nunes, Andreia Leite, Willemijn L. A. Schäfer, Claudia Valli, Ismael Martínez-Nicolas, Ayshe Seyfulayeva, Pedro Casaca Carvalho, Anna Rodríguez, Daniel Arnal-Velasco, Irene Leon, Carola Orrego, Paulo Sousa, on behalf of the SAFEST Consortium and the SAFEST Scientifi
pmc-11498713.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). A Core Measures Set (CMS) is an agreed standardized group of measures that should be assessed and reported in research for a specific condition or clinical area. This study undertook the development of a CMS for Patient Safety through a two-round, web-based Delphi consensus approach, in the context of the “Improving quality and patient SAFEty in surgical care through STandardisation and harmonization of perioperative care in Europe” (SAFEST) project—a collaborative, patient-centered and evidence-based European Union-funded project that aims to generate action-oriented evidence

pmc-11738718.title: A Case of Overlapping Extrapyramidal Side Effects and Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome
pmc-11738718.creator: Jun Hua Phan, Kainechukwu Ugwu, Sally Li Er Fong
pmc-11738718.description: AimsNeuroleptic malignant syndrome (NMS) is a rare, life-threatening idiosyncratic reaction to medications, specifically dopamine receptor antagonists. We report a case of a patient who initially developed extrapyramidal side effects (EPSE) and subsequently developed NMS after being treated with flupentixol depot.MethodsA 64-year-old woman with an underlying recurrent depressive disorder with psychotic symptoms presented to a psychiatric hospital in June 2023.

pmc-12383658.title: Ex Vivo Characterization of Peritoneal Macrophages from Novel ABCA1-LSL and ABCG1-LSL Mice for Macrophage-Specific ABC-Transporter Overexpression
pmc-12383658.creator: Jing Echesabal-Chen, Lawrence Fernando, Ally Brawner, Achala Pokhrel, Kun Huang, Rhonda Reigers Powell, Terri Bruce, Jan Guz, Fu-Lei Tang, Alexander Awgulewitsch, Alexis Stamatikos, Guo-Chang Fan
pmc-12383658.description: Simple SummaryHeart disease and stroke are two major causes of death worldwide. Both conditions are caused by cholesterol accumulating in arteries. Two transporters, ABCA1 and ABCG1, may protect against heart disease and stroke by removing excess cholesterol from artery cells.

pmc-12402498.title: Synthesis and characterisation of new modified polyesteramide resins based on sunflower oil for anticorrosive protective coatings
pmc-12402498.creator: Ola A Abu Ali, Hossa F Al Shareef, Rasha Felaly, M M El-Sawy
pmc-12402498.description: Polyesteramide resins were successfully synthesized via aminolysis of sunflower oil with diethanolamine under mild catalytic conditions, yielding N,N-bis(2-hydroxyethyl) sunflower amide (HESA) with a hydroxyl value of 9.02 mg KOH/g. HESA was then polymerised with N,N-Bis(4-hydroxyphenyl)maleamic acid (BHPMA) and N,N-Bis(4-sulfonicphenyl)maleamic acid (BSPMA) to form modified polyesteramide resins for protective coating applications.

pmc-12868289.title: Liver fibrosis in biliary atresia: identification of the key gene EDIL3 via integrated bioinformatics
pmc-12868289.creator: Meng Kong, Jinhua Jia, Chuanyang Liu, Hongzhen Liu, Shisong Zhang
pmc-12868289.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundBiliary atresia (BA) is one of the most destructive liver and biliary diseases in neonates and is characterized by progressive fibrous inflammatory obstruction of the intrahepatic and extrahepatic bile ducts, ultimately leading to liver fibrosis and liver failure.
